projects.name: E-Commerce — Spring Boot + React
projects.description: Full-stack e-commerce platform with a React/TypeScript storefront and a Java Spring Boot backend exposing REST APIs for catalog, cart, and orders.
projects.problem: E-commerce apps often couple UI and business logic, making them hard to scale and maintain.
projects.solution: Separated a React front end from Spring Boot REST services with clean contracts for catalog, cart, and checkout.

projects.name: MERN E-Commerce
projects.description: End-to-end e-commerce app on the MERN stack — MongoDB, Express, React, and Node — with product browsing, cart, and order flows.
projects.problem: Small teams need a single stack to ship a storefront quickly without stitching many services.
projects.solution: Built one cohesive MERN app covering catalog, cart, auth, and orders with a shared JavaScript stack.

projects.name: Real-Time Chat App
projects.description: Real-time messaging app with live sockets, conversations, and presence built on a modern TypeScript full-stack.
projects.problem: Request/response APIs can't deliver the instant updates a chat experience needs.
projects.solution: Used socket-based streaming for live messages and presence, backed by a typed API and store.

projects.name: Spring Boot Microservices
projects.description: A microservices system in Java/Spring Boot with independent services, an API gateway, and service-to-service communication.
projects.problem: Monoliths make independent scaling and deployment of features difficult.
projects.solution: Split the domain into Spring Boot microservices behind an API gateway with clear service boundaries.

projects.name: TalentFlow — Recruitment Platform
projects.description: A recruitment platform that tracks candidates through a hiring pipeline with dashboards and reusable UI, built in TypeScript.
projects.problem: Hiring teams lose track of candidates across scattered spreadsheets and inboxes.
projects.solution: Modeled the hiring pipeline as stages with a dashboard so teams can move candidates and see status at a glance.

projects.name: BrandPulse — Social Monitoring
projects.description: A social-media monitoring dashboard that aggregates signals and surfaces sentiment and trends, built in TypeScript.
projects.problem: Brand mentions are scattered across channels with no single view of sentiment.
projects.solution: Aggregated signals into one dashboard with sentiment gauges and trend lines for quick insight.

projects.name: PropertyIQ — Real Estate
projects.description: A real-estate application with property listings, metrics, and analytics panels built on a TypeScript full-stack.
projects.problem: Buyers and agents struggle to compare properties and their key metrics side by side.
projects.solution: Surfaced listings with price and metric panels and map context for faster comparison.

projects.name: Accountill — Invoicing App
projects.description: An invoicing and accounting app to create, send, and track invoices with line items and reporting.
projects.problem: Freelancers and small businesses need simple, trackable invoicing without heavy accounting software.
projects.solution: Built a lightweight invoicing app with line items, status tracking, and summaries.

projects.name: Personal AI Assistant
projects.description: A personal AI assistant with chat and document retrieval (RAG) over your own content, built in TypeScript.
projects.problem: General chatbots don't know your personal or project-specific context.
projects.solution: Grounded an LLM in your own documents with retrieval so answers cite your real context.

projects.name: Distributed Bookstore App
projects.description: A distributed bookstore application in Java demonstrating service decomposition, data access, and reliability patterns.
projects.problem: A single-process store app can't scale reads and writes independently or stay resilient.
projects.solution: Decomposed the bookstore into services with a database layer and reliability-minded patterns.

projects.name: StreamLedger — Real-Time Ledger
projects.description: A real-time financial ledger in Go that streams transactions into an append-only, auditable store.
projects.problem: Financial systems need an accurate, tamper-evident record as transactions arrive in real time.
projects.solution: Streamed transactions into an append-only ledger for a reliable, auditable history.
